notes: ⚠️ JAVASCRIPT-RENDERED (React/iHouseweb platform): This site requires Playwright or Selenium. The page uses React to dynamically load listings - static HTML fetch returns only a loading placeholder. The actual listing data is loaded via JavaScript after page render. To scrape this site: 1) Use Playwright/Selenium with wait conditions for content to load, 2) Inspect the rendered DOM to identify actual selectors for listing containers and fields, 3) The site is built on iHouseweb platform which is commonly used by real estate/business brokers. May also have an API endpoint that could be discovered through browser DevTools network inspection.
